identity.name: Kerberos Relay Attack via SMB and LSASS Dumping
identity.summary: An attacker performs a Kerberos relay attack by capturing authentication tickets and relaying them to target systems. The attack involves SMB connections and dumping LSASS memory to extract credential
identity.description: An attacker performs a Kerberos relay attack by capturing authentication tickets and relaying them to target systems. The attack involves SMB connections and dumping LSASS memory to extract credentials. Cortex should detect the unusual SMB connection patterns and LSASS process behavior.

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: Unusual SMB Connection to IPC$ Share
biocs.description: Detection of SMB connection to IPC$ share with no user context
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK_CONNECTION
| filter action_remote_ip = '192.0.2.100'
| filter dst_port = 445
| filter action_process_image_name != 'svchost.exe'
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name = 'net.exe'

abiocs.name: LSASS Memory Dumping Behavior
abiocs.description: Detection of LSASS process being executed with unusual flags or in an abnormal context
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'lsass.exe'
| filter actor_process_image_name != 'services.exe'
| filter actor_process_image_name != 'svchost.exe'

xql_queries.name: SMB Connection to IPC$ Hunt
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK_CONNECTION
| filter action_remote_ip = '192.0.2.100'
| filter dst_port = 445
| filter action_process_image_name != 'svchost.exe'
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name = 'net.exe'
| comp count() as cnt by action_remote_ip, action_process_image_name
| comp count() as cnt by
